entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an order. Just send me the label.
I can certainly help you with a return. To make sure I get you the right information, could I get your order number please?
Okay, I see the order here. Received five days ago. To process this correctly, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The color on the website looked much darker. It's not what I wanted.
I understand. Color can definitely look different on various screens. So just to confirm for my notes, there are no issues with the item's fit or any concerns about its safety features?
No. The box is unopened. I just want to return it and get a different one. Can we get this done?

Absolutely. Since it's unfortunately outside the 10-day return period for our gear, I can process that for you right now. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label and I've just sent it to the email address on your account. Do you see it?
Let me check... yes, I have the email. That's all I need?

That's it. Just print that label, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
